svg.title: cg-03 Dose documentation (Caregiver Mobile App)
svg.desc: Two low-fidelity phone frames for Tasha Greene documenting doses for Samuel Greer (C-30015) at 08:20 on 2026-09-15: A the list of overdue, due and as-needed medications with an allergy banner, B the outcome sheet for Lisinopril with Refused selected, a required reason picker and a consecutive-refusal warning. Numbered callouts 1 to 8.

g.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
g.text: B. Outcome sheet with reason picker
